turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|ASSAY| C[Read document]
    C --> D[Compress to floor content]
    D --> E[Name evaporated content and function]
    E --> F[Locate operative sentence]
    F --> G[Report ratio, erosion direction, and flags]
    G --> H["This is a finding, not a draft."]
    H --> Z[Stop]

    B -->|PROVIDE| I{Mode stated or inferable?}
    I -->|No| J[Ask for mode]
    J --> K[Wait for answer]
    K --> I
    I -->|Yes| L[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    L --> M{Floor passes?}
    M -->|No| N[Ask gaps or state assumptions]
    N --> K
    M -->|Yes| O[Compress prompt]
    O --> P{Cut removed specification?}
    P -->|Yes| Q[Name failure and revert]
    Q --> O
    P -->|No| R{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    R -->|No| S{Floor still passes?}
    S -->|No| T[Return last passing version]
    S -->|Yes| O
    T --> U[Output prompt and Cut line]
    R -->|Yes| U
    U --> V["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]
    V -->|Keep negotiating| O
    V -->|Human freezes| W{Execution tools available?}
    W -->|No| X[Gate stays closed]
    W -->|Yes| Y["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    Y --> AA{Result}
    AA -->|Success| AB[Done]
    AA -->|Floor item fails| AC["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    AC --> O
```
